research_boundary: Research infrastructure for in silico materials science discovery. Outputs are research artifacts. No regulatory certification claims. No clinical or human-subject use. ITAR / weapons applications are out of scope (Meta UMA Acceptable Use Policy and operator policy).
name: Toy Li-Cl halide CALPHAD database
purpose: Battery sidecar TDB fixture for the L3 halide-electrolyte arm (PRD §Scope Li-Mg-Zr-Cl seed; PRD §L3 'produced TDB must parse in pycalphad').
notes: DELIBERATELY synthetic. Two phases: LIQUID with one excess term and LICL_RS (rocksalt). Schema and syntax follow standard TDB conventions. pycalphad parses this TDB cleanly when installed; parser-only syntactic test runs without pycalphad.
